instruction: Explain how to activate Do Not Disturb mode for uninterrupted focus time.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Do Not Disturb mode is a system notification setting that cannot be reliably verified programmatically. While the setting might be toggled in the UI, verifying its actual state and effect on notifications requires access to system notification services that are not available in the evaluation framework.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'infeasible' function for a task that cannot be reliably verified programmatically
Do Not Disturb mode verification requires access to system notification services which are not available in the evaluation framework
While the UI toggle could be detected, verifying the actual suppression of notifications (the real requirement) is not feasible
The metadata explanation correctly identifies why this task is infeasible
Proper semantic judgment: marking as infeasible is better than creating a false/incomplete verification that only checks UI state without verifying actual notification blocking behavior
